training.method: Frozen shared trunk and policy; calibrate value_hidden/value with exact route/resource features and depth-five teacher root scores.

evaluation.known_regression: Standard opening as second player: previous 74-ply win becomes a 41-ply loss. Route variant retains a standard-opening second-player win.
evaluation.selection_note: The development suite was relabelled for training. Extra opening states and their symmetries were excluded from this round of training; extra games were used to compare candidate models. Fixed small suites are not an unbiased win-rate estimate.

alternatives.canonical_second_player: 78-ply win, independently reproduced through web API before selecting the value-only model.
